conclusions.topic: Root cause - MC UC holder press
conclusions.statement_from_report: Press of holder MC UC have problem -> Press not good -> Bond NG not dry. Bonding SP offset -> Ass'y coil SP not good (little bond) -> bond not dry.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Bond-amount and UV-LED spec changes alone could not fix Not-Dry (100% NG sustained at 0.08-0.16 Mg and increased UV). AWF jig open area also kept 100% NG. Replacing MC UC holder to gap 0.02 + 1:1 dropped Not-Dry NG to 0% (16/16). A subsequent 130-pcs run showed 5.38% NG explained by bonding SP offset (positions 1/2 vs 3/4 in 14-piece check), and re-setting bonding returned NG to 0%. So Not-Dry root cause is press/holder pressure variation, not bond amount or UV energy.

document.title: Coil SP UV LED 건조 후 Bond Not Dry NG 검토
document.purpose: Coil SP 본딩+UV LED 건조 후 Bond Not Dry 원인 분석. 본드량, UV LED, AWF jig 개구, MC UC 신규 홀더까지 단계적 시험.
content: 1.1 본드량 0.08~0.16Mg + UV LED spec up → 100% NG.
1.2 AWF jig 개구 컷팅 → 100% NG.
1.3 신규 MC UC 홀더(gap 0.02 + 1:1) → 0% NG. 후속 130개 lot 5.38% NG는 bonding SP offset → 본딩 재세팅 시 0%.

concl_root.statement_from_report: MC UC 홀더 press 문제 → press 부족 → Bond not dry. Bonding SP offset → coil SP 본드 적음 → not dry.
concl_root.normalized_interpretation: 본드량·UV LED 변화로는 100%→100% NG 미개선, AWF 개구도 100% NG. 신규 MC UC 홀더로 0% NG. 130개 lot 5.38%는 bonding SP offset(위치 1/2 vs 3/4), 본딩 재세팅 시 0%. 근본원인은 press/홀더이고 본드량·UV는 아님.

hint_0.check_item: Bond Not Dry 발생 시 본드량·UV LED 올리지 말고 MC UC 홀더 press 균일성(gap 0.02 + 1:1)과 bonding SP 위치 우선 점검.
hint_0.reason: 본드 0.08→0.16Mg + UV peak 336→696 → 100% NG 유지. 신규 홀더 시 0%. SP offset 5.38%는 재세팅 시 0%.

log.decision_rationale: 본드량→UV→AWF→홀더 순차 시험에서 홀더 변경이 단독으로 100%→0% 전환을 만든 process_condition_change.

document.title: Bond Not Dry NG on Coil SP after UV LED dry - investigation
document.purpose: Investigate Bond Not Dry root cause on Coil SP after UV LED dry by testing bond amount, UV LED energy, AWF jig open area, and MC UC new holder in sequence.
content: 1.1 Bond amount 0.08-0.16Mg + UV LED spec-up: NG remains 100%.
1.2 AWF jig open area: NG remains 100%.
1.3 New MC UC holder (gap 0.02 + 1:1): NG = 0%. Follow-up 130-pcs run 5.38% NG explained by bonding SP offset; re-set bonding -> 0%.

concl_root.topic: Root cause - MC UC holder press
concl_root.statement_from_report: MC UC holder press is the problem -> press not good -> bond not dry. Bonding SP offset -> coil SP gets little bond -> not dry.
concl_root.normalized_interpretation: Bond amount and UV LED changes kept NG 100%, AWF open area kept NG 100%, but new MC UC holder dropped NG to 0%. Subsequent 130-pcs run had 5.38% NG due to bonding SP offset (positions 1/2 vs 3/4); re-set bonding restored 0%. Root cause is press/holder pressure variation, not bond amount or UV energy.

hint_0.check_item: When Bond Not Dry occurs, do not raise bond amount or UV LED energy first - check MC UC holder press uniformity (gap 0.02 + 1:1) and bonding SP centering.
hint_0.reason: Bond 0.08->0.16Mg + UV peak 336->696 left NG at 100%; new holder dropped NG to 0%; 5.38% offset case fixed by bonding re-set.

1.2 AWF jig cutting: NG 100%.
1.3 Holder MC UC mới (gap 0.02 + 1:1): NG = 0%. Lot 130pcs sau đó 5.38% NG do bonding SP offset; reset bonding -> 0%.

concl_root.topic: Nguyên nhân gốc - press holder MC UC
